policy.capped_readings: distance>=100: bearing candidates only; no M5 point or distance residual computed
policy.unambiguous: one raw detection to one true target under both gates; capped candidates never called uncapped identification
policy.limits: geometric attribution is not visual verification; clipping, multiple candidates, model extrapolation require original PNG review
policy.time: native deterministic tick * 0.02s; zero-based raw lines/event indices
policy.scope: offline evidence only; no detector change, runtime truth use, or performance statistics
